signature: SUBROUTINE DLARFG( N, ALPHA, X, INCX, TAU )

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the elementary reflector.

params.name: alpha
params.reference: On entry, the value $\alpha$. On exit, it is overwritten with the value $\beta$.

params.name: x
params.reference: On entry, the vector x. On exit, it is overwritten with the vector v.

params.name: incx
params.reference: The increment between elements of X. $\mathrm{INCX} > 0$.

overrides.reason: Callers pass ALPHA and TAU as elements of their own arrays (A(i,i) and TAU(i) in dgeqr2 and the other QR/LQ/Hessenberg/bidiagonal reductions), which DLARFG updates in place, so they keep `x, offsetX` instead of a length-1 array every caller would copy in and out (S10, ruled 2026-11-19).
